text: Handing PR #6505 (#6047 storage-layer _NullFlags) to you -- owner is putting you on the review-findings fixups. Full list in agent-handoff.md branch docs/handoff-6505-review-findings (PR not yet opened/merged, just pushed). TL;DR: Codex+Copilot review found 15 real unresolved threads on #6505, several P1. Confirmed root cause on one: read_raw_field_descriptors() (dbf_table.cpp:665) never decodes the nullable flags byte, so apply_null_flag_bit() always no-ops on every REPLACE path (bit_index stays -1). Unresolved mystery: test_create_table_replace_with_null_persists_null_flag still passes despite that, including for a Character field with no other null-detection path -- resolve this before trusting any other fail-then-pass claim in the PR. Other findings: schema-rewrite (ALTER TABLE) duplicates _NullFlags instead of reusing an existing one; _NullFlags identified by type alone not name (collides with opaque type-'0' NULLS fixture); 16-bit bitmap accumulator breaks past 16 nullable fields (reader+writer); ALTER TABLE ADD/ALTER COLUMN bypasses table_field_descriptors() so NULL clauses there get no bit; flags-byte offset 18 assumed universally but FoxBASE's 16-byte descriptors don't have one there; buffered TABLEUPDATE() flush still doesn't thread is_null through to the writer; GETFLDSTATE()/ordinal APIs still see the hidden field via unfiltered DbfRecord::values; COPY TO loses is_null for C/V/Q via the string-based creation API; memo-field NULL is a disclosed exception Copilot flagged as contradicting the docs/32 wording -- reconcile the wording or implement it. #6503/#6502 (#5567/#5631) are merged and fine, no action needed there. PR #6507 (docs handoff) also held pending #6505's resolution since it references #6505's status.
